artifactDistribution.artifactCommitPolicy: The Git commit that distributes these current SBOM files is artifact-only and is not a new SBOM scan source. Its commit SHA is intentionally not recorded here because a tracked file cannot contain the SHA of its own commit.

relationshipToProductSbom.description: Test sample firmware may be built using MCU Driver components described in the Product SBOM. These product components are not duplicated in the Test Sample SBOM.

scopeRule.productSbom: Use as the primary SBOM for product vulnerability assessment and CRA product component transparency.
scopeRule.testSampleSbom: Use only when sample, demo, validation, or test-only components are reused, executed, distributed, or integrated by the customer.
scopeRule.separationRationale: Product and Test Sample SBOMs are kept separate to avoid treating test/sample utilities as product runtime dependencies.

customerGuidance: Use the Product SBOM as the primary input for product vulnerability assessment.
Review the Test Sample SBOM only when the corresponding sample/demo/test components are used or redistributed.
Components in the Test Sample SBOM are not considered product firmware/runtime dependencies unless explicitly integrated by the user.
notes: This manifest is an index for the SBOM package; it is not a merged CycloneDX BOM.
The Test Sample Grype report records five CPE-based matches for FreeRTOS-Kernel 10.5.1: one Critical and four High.
Findings are disclosed; Product Security disposition remains pending. This package publishes no VEX, not-affected, or approval assertion.
